The '''mayor''' of a small town is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP041|Wake Up Snorlax!]]''.

After {{Ash}} and {{Ashfr}} entered the town looking for food, the mayor took them in and provided them with a meal. As they were eating, the mayor explained the town's river had gone dry, and they didn't have any food as a result. Ash and the others decided to investigate, and they found a {{p|Snorlax}} had fallen asleep and was blocking the water from filling the river. Thanks to a [[hippie]] and his [[Poké Flute]], the Snorlax moved out of the way and the town's water supply was restored. The mayor thanked the children by providing them with a banquet.
